name: Suspicion
descriptionTemplate:
If the Research Team count is 0, this card becomes {Stagger}. If this card is still in hand at turn end, all enemies gain [Arg1] {STR} at the start of next turn.
The research team's {Suspicion} of Helot is growing, and you must come up with a way to calm them down before the enemies find you.

Arg1.displayFormula: 1% of stage power with Suspicion resonance; otherwise 1.5% (rounded up)
